_comment: 动作 = 显示名(中文, 给 Qwen 和最终输出) + prompt_en(给 X-CLIP 的英文描述)。列表按我看抽帧猜的工序写, 请按实际工序修改。

actions.name: 拿起产品
actions.prompt_en: a hand picks up a small white electronic device from the tray on the workbench

actions.name: 贴黑垫子
actions.prompt_en: hands peel a small black adhesive pad and stick it onto the white electronic device

actions.name: 扫码
actions.prompt_en: scanning the electronic device with a handheld barcode scanner emitting red light

actions.name: 放下产品
actions.prompt_en: a hand puts the small white electronic device down onto the tray

background_prompts_en: an empty green workbench with a tray, no hands visible
hands resting idle on the workbench, no activity
